basic_info.description: Hidden away on the street that birthed our city, a one-of-a-kind property awaits. This fully detached, house-like, 3-level cottage masterfully blends vintage charm w/ modern sophistication. Nestled in the heart of one of SF's most vibrant neighborhoods, it offers a rare combination of energy and tranquilityyour own private oasis in the city. Truly, the best of both worlds.  This property is all about character: rustic wood floors conceal updated radiant heating, a serene living room, and a funky stainless kitchen that's perfect for casual dinners or pre-Valencia cocktails. Enjoy a cozy dining nook, a moody bath, and front porch w/ in-unit laundry. Upstairs, two peaceful sunlight bedrooms, while the lower level is a versatile suite that can flex as a luxe primary retreat, professional recording/creative studio, or a hangout-ready media room, complete w/ its own bath.  Every inch has been dialed in: updated systems, on-demand hot water, modern lighting, and a floating matt-slab foundation built to laugh off earthquakes. Located on a tree-lined street, you're steps from Valencia's hottest spotsthink craft cocktails, indie coffee shops, and Michelin-star eatsplus effortless access to all transportation.  Come see what life could look like at 49A Albionwhere vintage meets vibe.
